name: slow
description: A long-running turn (delay_ms before and after the tool call), for tests that need a job to still be 'running' when they check on it: lock conflicts, agy_wait polling with a real state change, cancel, and timeout. The real-time delay comes entirely from `delay_ms` (agy.mjs sleeps before ever invoking the hook), so CommandLine itself does not need to actually sleep — it is `git status` so the step is also gate-allowed under both shipped profiles (0.2.0: PR2 denies anything unmatched).
